# `adt gcts`

SAP gCTS (git-enabled CTS) operations (repo/branch/commit/...)

```bash
adt gcts [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command            | Description                                                                      |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `adt gcts repo`    | Manage gCTS repositories                                                         |
| `adt gcts branch`  | Manage gCTS branches                                                             |
| `adt gcts commit`  | Commit a package or transport (POST /repository/&lt;rid&gt;/commit)              |
| `adt gcts log`     | Show repository commit history (GET /repository/&lt;rid&gt;/getCommit)           |
| `adt gcts objects` | List repository objects (GET /repository/&lt;rid&gt;/getObjects)                 |
| `adt gcts config`  | Manage repository configuration (GET/POST/DELETE /repository/&lt;rid&gt;/config) |

## `adt gcts repo`

Manage gCTS repositories

```bash
adt gcts repo [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command                  | Description                                                                               |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `adt gcts repo list`     | List all gCTS repositories (GET /repository)                                              |
| `adt gcts repo create`   | Create a new gCTS repository (POST /repository)                                           |
| `adt gcts repo clone`    | Clone repository on target system (POST /repository/&lt;rid&gt;/clone)                    |
| `adt gcts repo delete`   | Delete a gCTS repository (DELETE /repository/&lt;rid&gt;)                                 |
| `adt gcts repo pull`     | Pull a gCTS repository (GET /repository/&lt;rid&gt;/pullByCommit)                         |
| `adt gcts repo push`     | Push a gCTS repository (GET /repository/&lt;rid&gt;/push)                                 |
| `adt gcts repo checkout` | Check out a branch (GET /repository/&lt;rid&gt;/branches/&lt;current&gt;/switch?branch=X) |

### `adt gcts repo list`

List all gCTS repositories (GET /repository)

```bash
adt gcts repo list [options]
```

**Options**

| Option   | Description    | Default |
| -------- | -------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output as JSON |         |

### `adt gcts repo create`

Create a new gCTS repository (POST /repository)

```bash
adt gcts repo create [options] <rid> <url>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description           | Default |
| -------- | --------------------- | ------- |
| `<rid>`  | Repository ID         |         |
| `<url>`  | Git URL (https://...) |         |

**Options**

| Option                    | Description                      | Default  |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------- | -------- |
| `--vsid <vsid>`           | Virtual system ID                | `6IT`    |
| `--role <role>`           | Repository role (SOURCE\|TARGET) | `SOURCE` |
| `--type <type>`           | Repository type (GITHUB\|GIT)    | `GITHUB` |
| `--starting-folder <dir>` | Repository start dir             | `src/`   |
| `--vcs-token <token>`     | VCS authentication token         |          |
| `--json`                  | Output response as JSON          |          |

## `adt gcts branch`

Manage gCTS branches

```bash
adt gcts branch [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command                  | Description                                                                  |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `adt gcts branch list`   | List branches of a repository (GET /branches)                                |
| `adt gcts branch create` | Create a new branch (POST /branches)                                         |
| `adt gcts branch delete` | Delete a branch (DELETE /branches/&lt;name&gt;)                              |
| `adt gcts branch switch` | Switch branches (GET /branches/&lt;current&gt;/switch?branch=&lt;target&gt;) |

### `adt gcts branch list`

List branches of a repository (GET /branches)

```bash
adt gcts branch list [options] <rid>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description   | Default |
| -------- | ------------- | ------- |
| `<rid>`  | Repository ID |         |

**Options**

| Option         | Description                        | Default |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-r, --remote` | Show remote branches only          |         |
| `-a, --all`    | Show all branches (local + remote) |         |
| `--json`       | Output as JSON                     |         |

### `adt gcts branch create`

Create a new branch (POST /branches)

```bash
adt gcts branch create [options] <rid> <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description   | Default |
| -------- | ------------- | ------- |
| `<rid>`  | Repository ID |         |
| `<name>` | Branch name   |         |

**Options**

| Option         | Description                | Default |
| -------------- | -------------------------- | ------- |
| `--local-only` | Create a local branch only |         |
| `--symbolic`   | Create a symbolic ref      |         |
| `--peeled`     | Create a peeled ref        |         |
| `--json`       | Output response as JSON    |         |

### `adt gcts branch delete`

### `adt gcts branch switch`

Switch branches (GET /branches/&lt;current&gt;/switch?branch=&lt;target&gt;)

```bash
adt gcts branch switch [options] <rid> <target> [current]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument    | Description                         | Default |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<rid>`     | Repository ID                       |         |
| `<target>`  | Target branch name                  |         |
| `[current]` | Current branch (defaults to "main") |         |

**Options**

| Option   | Description             | Default |
| -------- | ----------------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output response as JSON |         |

## `adt gcts commit`

Commit a package or transport (POST /repository/&lt;rid&gt;/commit)

```bash
adt gcts commit [options] <rid>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description   | Default |
| -------- | ------------- | ------- |
| `<rid>`  | Repository ID |         |

**Options**

| Option                 | Description                                       | Default |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-m, --message <text>` | Commit message (default: auto-generated)          |         |
| `-d, --devc <pkg>`     | ABAP package name (defaults to &lt;rid&gt;)       |         |
| `--corrnr <tr>`        | Transport number (mutually exclusive with --devc) |         |
| `--description <text>` | Long commit description                           |         |
| `--json`               | Output response as JSON                           |         |

## `adt gcts config`

Manage repository configuration (GET/POST/DELETE /repository/&lt;rid&gt;/config)

```bash
adt gcts config [options] <rid> [action] [key] [value]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument   | Description                                 | Default |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<rid>`    | Repository ID                               |         |
| `[action]` | get \| set \| unset \| list (default: list) | `list`  |
| `[key]`    | Config key (for get/set/unset)              |         |
| `[value]`  | Config value (for set)                      |         |

**Options**

| Option   | Description    | Default |
| -------- | -------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output as JSON |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
